price_list_items_variant_key.name: price_list_items_variant_key
price_list_items_variant_key.where: "price_list_items"."variant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "price_list_items"."deleted_at" IS NULL

support_access_expiry_recorded_check.name: support_access_expiry_recorded_check
support_access_expiry_recorded_check.value: "support_access_grants"."expiry_recorded_at" IS NULL OR ("support_access_grants"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "support_access_grants"."expiry_recorded_at" >= "support_access_grants"."expires_at")

role_assignments_scope_check.name: role_assignments_scope_check
role_assignments_scope_check.value: ("role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'tenant' AND "role_assignments"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("role_assignments"."scope_type" IN ('brand', 'outlet', 'station') AND "role_assignments"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

roles_template_check.name: roles_template_check
roles_template_check.value: ("roles"."is_template" AND "roles"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."template_key" <> 'super_admin') OR (NOT "roles"."is_template" AND "roles"."template_key" IS NULL)

inventory_items_par_check.name: inventory_items_par_check
inventory_items_par_check.value: ("inventory_items"."par_min" IS NULL OR "inventory_items"."par_min" >= 0) AND ("inventory_items"."par_max" IS NULL OR "inventory_items"."par_max" >= 0) AND ("inventory_items"."par_min" IS NULL OR "inventory_items"."par_max" IS NULL OR "inventory_items"."par_max" >= "inventory_items"."par_min")

stock_ledger_direction_check.name: stock_ledger_direction_check
stock_ledger_direction_check.value:
(
        ("stock_ledger"."movement_type" IN ('receipt', 'production_in', 'transfer_in') AND "stock_ledger"."quantity" > 0)
        OR ("stock_ledger"."movement_type" IN ('sale', 'production_out', 'transfer_out', 'waste', 'duty_meal') AND "stock_ledger"."quantity" < 0)
        OR ("stock_ledger"."movement_type" = 'adjustment')
        OR ("stock_ledger"."movement_type" = 'return' AND "stock_ledger"."source_type" = 'purchase_return' AND "stock_ledger"."quantity" < 0)
        OR ("stock_ledger"."movement_type" = 'return' AND "stock_ledger"."source_type" = 'order' AND "stock_ledger"."quantity" > 0)
      )

table_sessions_closed_pair_check.name: table_sessions_closed_pair_check
table_sessions_closed_pair_check.value: ("table_sessions"."status" IN ('closed', 'voided')) = ("table_sessions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "table_sessions"."closed_reason" IS NOT NULL)

payment_unallocated_funds_resolved_check.name: payment_unallocated_funds_resolved_check
payment_unallocated_funds_resolved_check.value: ("payment_unallocated_funds"."resolution" IS NULL AND "payment_unallocated_funds"."resolved_by" IS NULL AND "payment_unallocated_funds"."resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("payment_unallocated_funds"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_unallocated_funds"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_unallocated_funds"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

chart_of_accounts_report_group_type_chec.name: chart_of_accounts_report_group_type_check
chart_of_accounts_report_group_type_chec.value: ("chart_of_accounts"."report_group" IN ('cash_and_equivalents', 'current_asset', 'non_current_asset') AND "chart_of_accounts"."type" = 'asset') OR ("chart_of_accounts"."report_group" IN ('current_liability', 'non_current_liability') AND "chart_of_accounts"."type" = 'liability') OR ("chart_of_accounts"."report_group" = 'equity' AND "chart_of_accounts"."type" = 'equity') OR ("chart_of_accounts"."report_group" IN ('revenue', 'other_income') AND "chart_of_accounts"."type" = 'revenue') OR ("chart_of_accounts"."report_group" IN ('cogs', 'operating_expense', 'other_expense') AND "chart_of_accounts"."type" = 'expense')

fiscal_periods_closed_check.name: fiscal_periods_closed_check
fiscal_periods_closed_check.value: ("fiscal_periods"."status" = 'closed') = ("fiscal_periods"."closed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "fiscal_periods"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

fiscal_periods_reopened_check.name: fiscal_periods_reopened_check
fiscal_periods_reopened_check.value: ("fiscal_periods"."reopened_reason" IS NULL) = ("fiscal_periods"."reopened_by" IS NULL) AND ("fiscal_periods"."reopened_by" IS NULL) = ("fiscal_periods"."reopened_at" IS NULL)

period_reopen_requests_decided_check.name: period_reopen_requests_decided_check
period_reopen_requests_decided_check.value: ("period_reopen_requests"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected')) = ("period_reopen_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "period_reopen_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

login_challenges_brand_needs_tenant_chec.name: login_challenges_brand_needs_tenant_check
login_challenges_brand_needs_tenant_chec.value: "login_challenges"."brand_id" IS NULL OR "login_challenges"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL

service_charge_rules_published_meta_chec.name: service_charge_rules_published_meta_check
service_charge_rules_published_meta_chec.value:
("service_charge_rules"."status" = 'published') = ("service_charge_rules"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("service_charge_rules"."status" = 'published') = ("service_charge_rules"."published_by" IS NOT NULL)

tax_rules_published_meta_check.name: tax_rules_published_meta_check
tax_rules_published_meta_check.value:
("tax_rules"."status" = 'published') = ("tax_rules"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("tax_rules"."status" = 'published') = ("tax_rules"."published_by" IS NOT NULL)

tax_settings_published_meta_check.name: tax_settings_published_meta_check
tax_settings_published_meta_check.value:
("tax_settings"."status" = 'published') = ("tax_settings"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("tax_settings"."status" = 'published') = ("tax_settings"."published_by" IS NOT NULL)

approval_requests_amount_check.name: approval_requests_amount_check
approval_requests_amount_check.value: ("approval_requests"."amount_idr" IS NULL OR "approval_requests"."amount_idr" >= 0) AND ("approval_requests"."threshold_idr" IS NULL OR "approval_requests"."threshold_idr" >= 0)

approval_requests_decision_check.name: approval_requests_decision_check
approval_requests_decision_check.value: ("approval_requests"."status" IN ('approved', 'rejected')) = ("approval_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_requests"."reason" IS NOT NULL)

facility_rewards_daily_key.name: facility_rewards_daily_key
facility_rewards_daily_key.where: "facility_rewards"."business_date" IS NOT NULL AND "facility_rewards"."revoked_at" IS NULL

promotion_order_applications_release_che.name: promotion_order_applications_release_check
promotion_order_applications_release_che.value: ("promotion_order_applications"."status" = 'released') = ("promotion_order_applications"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "promotion_order_applications"."release_reason" IS NOT NULL)

promotion_redemptions_target_check.name: promotion_redemptions_target_check
promotion_redemptions_target_check.value: "promotion_redemptions"."promotion_id" IS NOT NULL OR "promotion_redemptions"."voucher_id" IS NOT NULL

promotions_quota_check.name: promotions_quota_check
promotions_quota_check.value: ("promotions"."quota_total" IS NULL OR "promotions"."quota_total" > 0) AND ("promotions"."quota_per_customer" IS NULL OR "promotions"."quota_per_customer" > 0)

vouchers_value_check.name: vouchers_value_check
vouchers_value_check.value: ("vouchers"."promotion_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("vouchers"."value_idr" IS NOT NULL AND "vouchers"."value_idr" > 0)

vouchers_redeemed_check.name: vouchers_redeemed_check
vouchers_redeemed_check.value: ("vouchers"."status" = 'redeemed') = ("vouchers"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "vouchers"."redeemed_order_id" IS NOT NULL)

service_requests_lifecycle_check.name: service_requests_lifecycle_check
service_requests_lifecycle_check.value:
("service_requests"."status" <> 'pending' OR "service_requests"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("service_requests"."status" <> 'acknowledged' OR ("service_requests"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "service_requests"."assigned_to" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("service_requests"."status" = 'resolved') = ("service_requests"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL))

orders_amounts_check.name: orders_amounts_check
orders_amounts_check.value: "orders"."subtotal_idr" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount_idr" >= 0 AND "orders"."service_charge_idr" >= 0 AND "orders"."tax_idr" >= 0 AND "orders"."total_idr" >= 0 AND "orders"."deposit_applied_idr" >= 0 AND "orders"."deposit_applied_idr" <= "orders"."total_idr"

reservation_policies_rules_check.name: reservation_policies_rules_check
reservation_policies_rules_check.value:
"reservation_policies"."payment_window_minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 1440
        AND "reservation_policies"."free_cancellation_hours" BETWEEN 0 AND 720
        AND "reservation_policies"."late_cancellation_refund_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
        AND "reservation_policies"."no_show_refund_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
        AND "reservation_policies"."default_duration_minutes" BETWEEN 15 AND 720
        AND "reservation_policies"."slot_interval_minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 240

reservations_seated_check.name: reservations_seated_check
reservations_seated_check.value: "reservations"."status" NOT IN ('seated', 'completed') OR ("reservations"."seated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reservations"."table_session_id" IS NOT NULL)

reservations_outcome_check.name: reservations_outcome_check
reservations_outcome_check.value:
("reservations"."deposit_refund_idr" IS NULL) = ("reservations"."deposit_forfeited_idr" IS NULL)
        AND ("reservations"."deposit_refund_idr" IS NULL OR ("reservations"."deposit_refund_idr" >= 0 AND "reservations"."deposit_forfeited_idr" >= 0))

facilities_minutes_check.name: facilities_minutes_check
facilities_minutes_check.value: "facilities"."session_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 480 AND "facilities"."cleaning_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 240 AND "facilities"."arrival_grace_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440 AND "facilities"."session_minutes" + "facilities"."cleaning_minutes" <= 720

facility_products_amount_check.name: facility_products_amount_check
facility_products_amount_check.value: "facility_products"."price_idr" >= 0 AND "facility_products"."sessions" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ("facility_products"."max_per_day" IS NULL OR "facility_products"."max_per_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

facility_subscription_plans_amount_check.name: facility_subscription_plans_amount_check
facility_subscription_plans_amount_check.value: "facility_subscription_plans"."price_idr" >= 0 AND "facility_subscription_plans"."quota_per_period" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND ("facility_subscription_plans"."max_per_day" IS NULL OR "facility_subscription_plans"."max_per_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

wifi_policies_amount_check.name: wifi_policies_amount_check
wifi_policies_amount_check.value: "wifi_policies"."free_minutes" >= 0 AND "wifi_policies"."peak_free_minutes" >= 0 AND "wifi_policies"."spend_per_extra_hour_idr" >= 0 AND "wifi_policies"."extra_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440 AND "wifi_policies"."max_devices" BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND "wifi_policies"."base_speed_kbps" >= 1 AND "wifi_policies"."full_speed_kbps" >= 1 AND ("wifi_policies"."min_spend_per_hour_idr" IS NULL OR "wifi_policies"."min_spend_per_hour_idr" >= 0)

employees_nik_pair_check.name: employees_nik_pair_check
employees_nik_pair_check.value: ("employees"."nik_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("employees"."nik_hmac" IS NULL) AND ("employees"."nik_hmac" IS NULL OR "employees"."nik_hmac" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

employees_npwp_pair_check.name: employees_npwp_pair_check
employees_npwp_pair_check.value: ("employees"."npwp_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("employees"."npwp_hmac" IS NULL) AND ("employees"."npwp_hmac" IS NULL OR "employees"."npwp_hmac" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

employees_bpjs_kes_no_pair_check.name: employees_bpjs_kes_no_pair_check
employees_bpjs_kes_no_pair_check.value: ("employees"."bpjs_kes_no_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("employees"."bpjs_kes_no_hmac" IS NULL) AND ("employees"."bpjs_kes_no_hmac" IS NULL OR "employees"."bpjs_kes_no_hmac" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

employees_bpjs_tk_no_pair_check.name: employees_bpjs_tk_no_pair_check
employees_bpjs_tk_no_pair_check.value: ("employees"."bpjs_tk_no_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("employees"."bpjs_tk_no_hmac" IS NULL) AND ("employees"."bpjs_tk_no_hmac" IS NULL OR "employees"."bpjs_tk_no_hmac" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

employees_bank_account_pair_check.name: employees_bank_account_pair_check
employees_bank_account_pair_check.value: ("employees"."bank_account_encrypted" IS NULL) = ("employees"."bank_account_hmac" IS NULL) AND ("employees"."bank_account_hmac" IS NULL OR "employees"."bank_account_hmac" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

employment_contracts_term_check.name: employment_contracts_term_check
employment_contracts_term_check.value: ("employment_contracts"."type" <> 'pkwt' OR "employment_contracts"."end_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("employment_contracts"."type" <> 'pkwtt' OR "employment_contracts"."end_date" IS NULL)

fixed_assets_disposal_check.name: fixed_assets_disposal_check
fixed_assets_disposal_check.value: ("fixed_assets"."status" = 'disposed') = ("fixed_assets"."disposed_on" IS NOT NULL AND "fixed_assets"."disposal_proceeds_idr" IS NOT NULL) AND ("fixed_assets"."disposal_proceeds_idr" IS NULL OR "fixed_assets"."disposal_proceeds_idr" >= 0) AND ("fixed_assets"."disposed_on" IS NULL OR "fixed_assets"."disposed_on" >= "fixed_assets"."acquired_on")

inventory_stock_alerts_shape_check.name: inventory_stock_alerts_shape_check
inventory_stock_alerts_shape_check.value:
("inventory_stock_alerts"."kind" = 'par_critical' AND "inventory_stock_alerts"."batch_id" IS NULL AND "inventory_stock_alerts"."par_min" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("inventory_stock_alerts"."kind" <> 'par_critical' AND "inventory_stock_alerts"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_stock_alerts"."expires_on" IS NOT NULL)

production_orders_completed_check.name: production_orders_completed_check
production_orders_completed_check.value:
("production_orders"."status" = 'completed') = ("production_orders"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("production_orders"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("production_orders"."actual_qty" > 0 AND "production_orders"."cost_idr" IS NOT NULL))

shift_handovers_acknowledged_check.name: shift_handovers_acknowledged_check
shift_handovers_acknowledged_check.value: ("shift_handovers"."status" = 'acknowledged') = ("shift_handovers"."acknowledged_by" IS NOT NULL AND "shift_handovers"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL)

temperature_logs_corrective_action_check.name: temperature_logs_corrective_action_check
temperature_logs_corrective_action_check.value: ("temperature_logs"."in_range" AND "temperature_logs"."corrective_action" IS NULL) OR (NOT "temperature_logs"."in_range" AND "temperature_logs"."corrective_action" IS NOT NULL)

edge_nodes_status_check.name: edge_nodes_status_check
edge_nodes_status_check.value: ("edge_nodes"."status" = 'active' AND "edge_nodes"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("edge_nodes"."status" = 'revoked' AND "edge_nodes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

edge_outbound_queue_status_check.name: edge_outbound_queue_status_check
edge_outbound_queue_status_check.value: ("edge_outbound_queue"."status" = 'pending' AND "edge_outbound_queue"."acked_at" IS NULL) OR ("edge_outbound_queue"."status" = 'acked' AND "edge_outbound_queue"."acked_at" IS NOT NULL)

pos_order_discounts_percent_check.name: pos_order_discounts_percent_check
pos_order_discounts_percent_check.value:
("pos_order_discounts"."kind" = 'percent') = ("pos_order_discounts"."percent_bp" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("pos_order_discounts"."percent_bp" IS NULL OR "pos_order_discounts"."percent_bp" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)

pos_order_discounts_approval_pair_check.name: pos_order_discounts_approval_pair_check
pos_order_discounts_approval_pair_check.value: ("pos_order_discounts"."approved_by" IS NULL) = ("pos_order_discounts"."approval_request_id" IS NULL AND "pos_order_discounts"."override_id" IS NULL)

pos_order_refunds_approval_check.name: pos_order_refunds_approval_check
pos_order_refunds_approval_check.value: "pos_order_refunds"."override_id" IS NOT NULL OR "pos_order_refunds"."approval_request_id" IS NOT NULL

pos_order_tenders_cash_check.name: pos_order_tenders_cash_check
pos_order_tenders_cash_check.value:
("pos_order_tenders"."method" = 'cash') = ("pos_order_tenders"."received_idr" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("pos_order_tenders"."received_idr" IS NULL) = ("pos_order_tenders"."change_idr" IS NULL)
        AND ("pos_order_tenders"."received_idr" IS NULL OR "pos_order_tenders"."change_idr" = "pos_order_tenders"."received_idr" - "pos_order_tenders"."amount_idr")
        AND ("pos_order_tenders"."change_idr" IS NULL OR "pos_order_tenders"."change_idr" >= 0)

pos_order_voids_approval_check.name: pos_order_voids_approval_check
pos_order_voids_approval_check.value: "pos_order_voids"."override_id" IS NOT NULL OR "pos_order_voids"."approval_request_id" IS NOT NULL
